payload.body: Dogfood gap (speed-count-game, 2026-07-23): a codex session could not discover nahel at all. Causes: (1) install only supports --agent claude (codex shims were roadmap Phase 5); (2) init leaves a pre-existing AGENTS.md untouched so the orientation section never lands where conversational agents read; (3) no PATH binary — bun-path invocation is unguessable. Machine-local mitigations only: ~/.local/bin/nahel wrapper, nahel section hand-appended to the repo AGENTS.md. Drove the Phase 2 distribution pull-forward (compiled binary, codex shim target, init AGENTS.md merge) and backlog item init-should-offer-agents-md-merge (pjcgrgx1).
